title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
abstract: arXiv:2610.29245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to run experiments, yet benchmarks rarely measure whether those experiments improve the decisions they are meant to inform. We introduce CrashGym, a deterministic, replayable limit-order-book simulator in which an agent must choose between a deleveraging intervention and a liquidity backstop for a market about to suffer a shock-triggered crash. Before committing, the agent may query intervention experiments in a laboratory realization of the market. Its choice is then scored on an independently seeded target realization in which the simulator executes every feasible intervention, so regret relative to the best intervention is computed by directly simulating every alternative on the same target repeats, with no human or model-based judging. The simulator implements each amplification channel---persistent price impact, liquidity withdrawal, margin-driven liquidation, and an evolving strategy mix

translated_title: CrashGym：在反事实市场崩盘中衡量实验对LLM智能体的决策价值
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体越来越多地被要求开展实验，然而现有基准测试很少衡量这些实验是否真正改善了它们旨在辅助的决策。我们提出了CrashGym，这是一个确定性、可重放的限价订单簿模拟器，其中智能体必须为一个即将遭受冲击引发崩盘的市场，在去杠杆干预与流动性支持两种方案之间做出选择。在最终决策之前，智能体可以在市场的实验室实现中查询干预实验。其选择随后在一个独立随机种子的目标实现上进行评分，模拟器在该实现中执行所有可行的干预方案，因此相对于最佳干预的遗憾值是通过在同一目标重复中直接模拟每一个备选方案来计算的，无需人工或基于模型的评判。该模拟器实现了每一个市场放大机制——持续的价格影响、流动性撤回、保证金驱动的强制清算以及不断演变的策略组合。
tldr: CrashGym是一个确定性、可重放的限价订单簿模拟器基准，通过让LLM智能体在市场崩盘前先进行干预实验再做出政策选择，并通过直接模拟所有可行干预方案来计算遗憾值，从而衡量实验对智能体决策的真实价值。
en_tdlr: CrashGym is a deterministic, replayable limit-order-book simulator benchmark that measures the true decision value of experimentation for LLM agents by letting them run intervention experiments before choosing between deleveraging and liquidity backstop policies, with regret computed by directly simulating every feasible alternative without any human or model-based judging.
